meta_description: RNT Decorating Ltd in Newcastle offers professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, quality finishes. Call 07966 147164.
hero_subhead: From interior refreshes to full exterior repaints, we transform your home with precision and care. Fast turnaround, no mess left behind.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Newcastle
services_subhead: From interior feature walls to full external repaints, we handle domestic and commercial projects of any size with attention to detail and minimal disruption.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Wall and ceiling painting, feature walls, and complete room refreshes. We prep properly, use quality paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior repaints, woodwork, fascia, and soffits. We use trade-grade materials built to withstand Newcastle's climate for years.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging, feature walls, and specialty finishes. We handle tricky corners and period properties with care.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Quick turnaround painting for offices, retail spaces, and industrial buildings. We work flexibly around your hours to minimise downtime.

services.title: Cabinet & Furniture Painting
services.desc: Transform tired kitchen cabinets and furniture with hard-wearing finishes. Perfect for updating your home without the cost of replacements.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Painting
services.desc: Expert painting of doors, skirting, architraves, and window frames. We sand, prime, and apply smooth, durable finishes that stand the test of time.

about_pullquote: We do the job right the first time, so you never have to worry about it again.
about_para_1: RNT Decorating Ltd was founded in 2006 by Rob, who grew frustrated with the lack of reliable, honest decorators in the North East. Starting as a one-man operation, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, delivering quality work, and treating every home as if it were our own. Today we're a small, tight-knit team based in Ponteland, serving Newcastle, Northumberland, and beyond.
about_para_2: We're known for meticulous prep work — proper sanding, filling, and priming make all the difference to a finished job. We don't cut corners, we don't leave mess, and we don't disappear when the snagging list arrives. Repeat customers make up nearly 40% of our work, which tells you everything about the service we deliver.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About RNT Decorating

reviews.text: Rob and the team came to repaint the whole of our Victorian terrace. They were professional, clean, and finished on time. The woodwork looks immaculate. Highly recommend — will be using them again for the kitchen.
reviews.author: Michael H.

reviews.text: Absolute game-changer. Our lounge was tired and dated. They suggested a feature wall and new paint scheme that transformed the space. Fair pricing, no mess, brilliant attention to detail. These are the decorators everyone should have.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Had the exterior of our cottage painted before winter. Rob explained everything, kept us updated, and the finish is stunning. Proper job. Best money we've spent on the house.
reviews.author: David P.
